limits.baseline: Local NOISY extension using published RED-diff awd=True,mcg=False coefficient sqrt(alpha_s*alpha_t). Not literal paperAlgorithm1 reproduction. A85 literal coefficient failed on real FFHQ before SHRINK.
limits.grid: 100 uniform indices990..0, final clean endpoint -1; original linear1000 beta schedule; eta1; pureGaussian initialization; raw clean prediction; returned final next-state.
limits.formula: rt_squared=1-alpha_t; v=Ht(HHt+sigma_y^2/rt_squared I)^-1(y-Hm); g=Jm^T v; q=sqrt(alpha_s*alpha_t)*g.
limits.operators: Model[-1,1], sigma=.05; averagePool4, normalizedGaussian61/sigma3 periodic, normalizedfrozenDPSMotion61 periodic, random70% missing observed-only RGB coordinates. NEW shared y/operator per pair, not A84 Gaussian.
limits.module: Unchanged A71 noise_signal_shrink.select on r=y-Hm and d=Hq/sqrt(alpha_t). Scale q only. Same-time identity clean-response proxy, no next-denoiser response claim.
limits.preserved: Original noisyPiGDM direction, DDIM coefficients/eta/noise/grid retained. Positive global correction amplitude may be canceled by gamma.
limits.pairing: Same observation/operator/init/finalCPU+CUDA RNG/grid/NN timestamps; independent from-seed runs, first image per task BASE first, remaining arm order alternates; no learned cache.
limits.cost: 100 forwards+100 inputVJP per run, no optimizer; SHRINK adds one Hq/step, residual reused. Analytic SR/mask and exactFFT blur solves, no CG or iterative tuning.
limits.timing: Complete100 includes given-y load/operator creation/init/sampling/CPU sync/bookkeeping. Load/probe/observation creation/metrics/artifact writes separate; same-session loop times, no claimed production speedup.
limits.admission: Required CUDA operator/gradient/forced-one/RNG and native-source update-equivalence gates. First one BASE per task must complete100 on actual weights before any SHRINK. Offline anomaly floor PSNR>=10,SSIM>=.1; no label-based tuning, fallback or sample substitution.
limits.decision: Each dataset/task: PSNRmean>=+.1dB, >=2of3 wins, SSIMnondecrease, LPIPSnonincrease, pairingpassed. Baseline PSNR<10 or SSIM<.1 flagged unqualified descriptively; all outputs retained, no policy fallback.
limits.limits: Three reused images/dataset, one seed, sigma.05 only. Different architecture+data together. Small local paired transfer; no state-necessity/universal/posterior guarantee. No fixed/mismatch arms.
limits.lineage: New root and new protocol. A85 failed22 forwards+22 VJPs and2 real probes retained and reported separately; no failed trajectory reuse. Existing A85 observations reused with binary hashes when present.
limits.probes: Two baseline workers then two comparison workers: nominal4 real-model forward+VJP probes/dataset, every load/resume counted. Baseline qualification runs are reused, not rerun.
limits.scope: Keep A85 operators,100 grid,eta1,pureGaussian init,shared observations and unchanged A71 gamma. Only restore published next-time coefficient and add staged qualification/diagnostics. Still a candidate local baseline until real run returns.
